provenance.canonical-source: packages/core/src/switch/{Switch.tsx,Switch.css,index.ts} — the whole component, three files, read in full. packages/core/stories/switch/{switch.stories.tsx,switch.qa.stories.tsx}; site/docs/components/switch/{index,usage,accessibility,examples}.mdx; site/src/examples/switch/{Default,DefaultChecked,Disabled,DisabledChecked,Readonly,LeftAlignedLabel}.tsx. Resolution through packages/theme/css/next/characteristics/{selectable,content,focused}.css, next/palette/{neutral,accent,background}.css, next/foundations/color.css, packages/theme/css/foundations/{size,spacing,curve,cursor,borderStyle,zindex}.css. NO validationStatus/status.css resolution — see behavior.validation absence, confirmed below.
provenance.no-validation: CONFIRMED ABSENCE, grepped directly: Switch.tsx has NO `validationStatus` prop, does not import `../form-field-context`'s validation field, and Switch.css has no `.saltSwitch-error`/`.saltSwitch-warning` class of any kind — unlike Checkbox.tsx, which pulls `checkboxGroup?.validationStatus ?? formFieldValidationStatus ?? validationStatusProp`. Switch's own `useFormFieldProps()` call destructures only `{ a11yProps, disabled, readOnly }`, deliberately NOT `validationStatus`, even though the same hook exposes it to Checkbox.
provenance.neutral: Switch.css `border-color: var(--salt-selectable-borderColor)` -> next/characteristics/selectable.css `--salt-selectable-borderColor: var(--salt-palette-neutral)` -> next/palette/neutral.css, `--salt-palette-neutral: var(--salt-color-gray-500)` IDENTICAL under both [data-mode] blocks -> foundations/color.css --salt-color-gray-500-rgb: 114, 119, 125. MODE-INVARIANT, the identical fact checkbox.salt.json already recorded for the same token, reused here because Switch.css resolves through the exact same characteristics file.
provenance.neutral-fg: Switch.css track's resting `color: var(--salt-selectable-foreground)` -> selectable.css -> `var(--salt-palette-neutral-strong)` -> neutral.css, NOT mode-invariant: gray-600 rgb(95,100,106) light, gray-400 rgb(145,149,154) dark — identical values to checkbox.salt.json's own neutral-fg slot.
provenance.accent: Switch.css `.saltSwitch-checked .saltSwitch-track { border-color: var(--salt-selectable-borderColor-selected); color: var(--salt-selectable-foreground-selected) }` -> selectable.css, BOTH -> `var(--salt-palette-accent)` -> next/palette/accent.css `--salt-palette-accent: var(--salt-color-blue-500)` identical in both mode blocks -> color.css --salt-color-blue-500-rgb: 0, 120, 207. MODE-INVARIANT, same value checkbox.salt.json already used. The `-hover` variant (`--salt-selectable-borderColor-hover`/`-foreground-hover`) resolves to the SAME accent slot, the identical hover-equals-selected coincidence checkbox.salt.json's own accent provenance already recorded.
provenance.box-bg: Switch.css `.saltSwitch-readOnly .saltSwitch-thumb { background: var(--salt-container-primary-background) }` -> next/characteristics/container.css -> next/palette/background.css, background-snow (light, rgb 255,255,255) / background-jet (dark, rgb 16,24,32) — the SAME slot and values checkbox.salt.json's box-bg already resolved; reused here for the readOnly thumb's fill, since it is the identical token.
provenance.text-fg: Switch.css `.saltSwitch { color: var(--salt-content-primary-foreground) }` -> next/characteristics/content.css `--salt-content-primary-foreground: var(--salt-palette-foreground-primary)` -> next/palette/foreground.css, black rgb(0,0,0) light / white rgb(255,255,255) dark (a genuinely NEW slot switch needs that checkbox's own root font never resolved through, since checkbox's root.font row never carried a colour) -> foundations/color.css --salt-color-black-rgb / --salt-color-white-rgb.
provenance.focus-outline: Switch.css `.saltSwitch-input:focus-visible + .saltSwitch-track { outline: var(--salt-focused-outline) }` -> next/characteristics/focused.css `--salt-focused-outline: 2px dotted var(--salt-focused-outlineColor)`, `--salt-focused-outlineColor: var(--salt-palette-accent-stronger)` -> palette/accent.css blue-700 rgb(0,69,126) light / blue-300 rgb(154,189,245) dark — the SAME slot and values checkbox.salt.json's focus-outline already resolved. NOTE, a real divergence from checkbox: Switch.css's own `outline-offset: var(--salt-focused-outlineOffset)` resolves to a LITERAL 0 (focused.css: `--salt-focused-outlineOffset: 0`), whereas checkbox's box used `outline-offset: var(--salt-spacing-fixed-100)` = 1px directly, NOT this same characteristic token — two different components reaching two different offsets through two different mechanisms, recorded rather than smoothed into one number.
provenance.byDensity.track-width/track-height: Switch.css `.saltSwitch-track { width: calc((var(--salt-size-selectable) + var(--salt-spacing-25) + var(--salt-size-fixed-100)) * 2); height: calc(var(--salt-size-base) - var(--salt-spacing-100)) }` -> foundations/size.css (size-selectable 12/14/16/18, size-base 20/28/36/44, size-fixed-100 1px FIXED) and foundations/spacing.css (spacing-100 4/8/12/16, spacing-25 = 0.25 * spacing-100 = 1/2/3/4), all by DENSITY (high/medium/low/touch). Computed: width = (selectable+spacing-25+1)*2 -> high (12+1+1)*2=28, medium (14+2+1)*2=34, low (16+3+1)*2=40, touch (18+4+1)*2=46. height = size-base - spacing-100 -> high 20-4=16, medium 28-8=20, low 36-12=24, touch 44-16=28.
provenance.byDensity.thumb-size: Switch.css `.saltSwitch-thumb { height: var(--salt-size-selectable) }` with `aspect-ratio: 1` — the SAME token AND the same per-density numbers (12/14/16/18) as checkbox.salt.json's own box-size.
provenance.byDensity.track-radius: Switch.css `.saltSwitch-track { border-radius: var(--salt-palette-corner-weak, 0) }` -> next/palette/corner.css `--salt-palette-corner-weak: var(--salt-curve-100)` -> foundations/curve.css, DENSITY scale 4/8/12/16 (high/medium/low/touch) — a DIFFERENT corner token from checkbox's box (which used corner-weaker/curve-50); under [data-corner="sharp"] this collapses to curve-0 = 0px, the identical edition trap CHIP-MATRIX finding-1 and checkbox's own track-radius-adjacent shape row both already recorded.
provenance.byDensity.thumb-radius: Switch.css `.saltSwitch-thumb { border-radius: var(--salt-palette-corner-weaker, 0) }` -> corner.css `--salt-palette-corner-weaker: var(--salt-curve-50)` -> curve.css, DENSITY scale 1/2/3/4 — the IDENTICAL token AND numbers checkbox.salt.json's own shape-radius slot already used.
provenance.byDensity.root-gap: Switch.css `.saltSwitch { gap: var(--salt-spacing-100) }` -> foundations/spacing.css, DENSITY scale 4/8/12/16 — the identical token AND numbers checkbox.salt.json's own root-gap slot already used.
provenance.byDensity.type-fontSize/type-lineHeight: Switch.css `.saltSwitch { font-size: var(--salt-text-fontSize); line-height: var(--salt-text-lineHeight); font-family: var(--salt-text-fontFamily); font-weight: var(--salt-text-fontWeight) }` -> next/characteristics/text.css, the BODY role, DENSITY scale 11/14 . 12/16 . 14/18 . 16/20 — identical to checkbox.salt.json's own root.font resolution. font-weight REGULAR (400).
provenance.border-width-fixed: Switch.css `.saltSwitch-track { border: var(--salt-size-fixed-100) ... }` and `.saltSwitch-thumb { border: var(--salt-size-fixed-100) ... }` -> foundations/size.css --salt-size-fixed-100: 1px, FIXED (density-invariant) scale, carried as a plain literal rather than a slot, matching checkbox's own convention for the identical token.
provenance.no-pressed-state: CONFIRMED ABSENCE, checked directly: Switch.css contains no `:active` selector of any kind.
provenance.no-group: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no SwitchGroup/switch-group export anywhere in packages/core/src/switch/index.ts or the wider package; unlike Checkbox, Switch composes with an ancestor <FormField> only, never its own group construct.
provenance.no-transition-on-track-hover: Switch.css's own transition rule is scoped ONLY to `.saltSwitch-input:focus-visible + .saltSwitch-track .saltSwitch-thumb, .saltSwitch:hover .saltSwitch-thumb { transition: transform var(--salt-duration-perceptible) ease-in-out }` — the THUMB's transform eases, but no colour property anywhere in Switch.css carries a `transition`, unlike checkbox's box (which had NO transition of any kind at all). This is a genuinely NEW, switch-only capability not modelled as its own row for scope (the thumb-slide easing is a single, narrow, single-property case; see the matrix doc's 'Declared approximations' for why it is noted, not expanded).

structure.shell.source: Switch.tsx returns <label className=saltSwitch>{input}{track{thumb{icon}}}{label}</label> — one real <label>, matching Checkbox.tsx's own shape exactly

structure.native-input.source: Switch.tsx <input type="checkbox" role="switch" ... /> — a real native input, opacity:0, position:absolute (Switch.css)

structure.track.source: Switch.tsx ... — a real, separate track element

structure.icon.source: Switch.tsx: {checked && !readOnly && <CheckmarkSolidIcon .../>} {checked && readOnly && <CheckmarkIcon .../>} — the identical readOnly-glyph-swap mechanism CheckboxIcon.tsx already used

behavior.role.value: explicit `role="switch"` written on the native <input type="checkbox">, with a biome-ignore comment noting aria-checked is unnecessary since input+checked already provides it
behavior.role.source: Switch.tsx: `role="switch"` plus `// biome-ignore lint/a11y/useAriaPropsForRole: aria-checked is not needed when input and checked is used.`

behavior.keyboard-activation.source: no onKeyDown anywhere in Switch.tsx; accessibility.mdx: 'Space activates switch to change between checked and unchecked state' — enterActivates=false, Space handled natively

behavior.label-click-target.value: the WHOLE label — track/thumb and text both toggle it

behavior.disabled-handling.value: native `disabled` on the input, merged with the ancestor FormField's (no group merge — switch has none), plus a blanket opacity class on the whole label
behavior.disabled-handling.source: Switch.tsx `const disabled = formFieldDisabled || disabledProp`; Switch.css `.saltSwitch-disabled { opacity: 0.4 }`

behavior.readonly.value: implemented in JS, NOT relying on the (spec-inert) native readonly attribute — identical mechanism to Checkbox

behavior.form-participation.value: native — the input IS the real form control
behavior.form-participation.source: a real <input type="checkbox" name=... value=... checked=.../>, no custom validity machinery needed

prop.checked-shape.source: SwitchProps: `checked?: boolean; defaultChecked?: boolean` — NO indeterminate field anywhere

prop.disabled.source: SwitchProps.disabled?: boolean, merged with the ancestor FormField's

prop.required.note: reachable only via `inputProps.required` (SwitchProps has no top-level `required` field), the same indirect shape checkbox's Salt column used

prop.size.note: density (a registry-wide, document-level axis) plays the equivalent role but is a different mechanism, not a per-instance prop — see the template row's note

prop.icons.note: Salt's icon visibility is driven entirely by checked/readOnly state (see structure.icon), not an opt-in toggle

slot.label.value: label?: ReactNode, rendered as the LAST child inside the component's own <label>

slot.composes.note: form-field (useFormFieldProps() pulls aria-describedby/aria-labelledby/disabled/readOnly down from an ancestor <FormField> — Switch.tsx), checkbox/radio-button/toggle-button (the three explicitly-excluded siblings, usage.mdx)

state.rest.value: neutral gray-500 outline on a white/near-black track fill; a SOLID currentColor thumb with a matching neutral border
state.rest.note: an outline-style track at EVERY state, including checked — see state.checked

state.checked.value: track fill NEVER changes — only track border/icon recolour to accent; thumb INVERTS from solid currentColor to transparent (outline-only), sliding via translateX(100%)
state.checked.note: the fill direction is the OPPOSITE of checkbox's box, which stayed outline-only at every state

state.hover.value: track border+icon AND thumb border recolour to the -hover variant, keyed off the ROOT's :hover

state.focus.value: 2px dotted accent-stronger outline at ZERO offset, plus the hover recolour riding along

state.disabled.value: blanket opacity 0.4 (a literal) on the whole label, plus not-allowed cursor

state.readonly.value: track border recolours to a dedicated readonly token; thumb is FORCED to the neutral/rest look in BOTH checked and unchecked states; root cursor becomes text, not not-allowed
state.readonly.source: Switch.css `.saltSwitch-readOnly .saltSwitch-track`, `.saltSwitch-readOnly .saltSwitch-thumb, .saltSwitch-readOnly.saltSwitch-checked .saltSwitch-thumb` (identical rule for both), `.saltSwitch-readOnly { cursor: var(--salt-cursor-text) }`

style.track.size@sm.note: Salt has no size prop — density plays the equivalent role, see prop.size

style.track.rest.note: box-bg is REUSED from checkbox's identical container-primary-background token — Switch.css does not restate a rest background rule of its own beyond `.saltSwitch-track { background: var(--salt-container-primary-background) }`, which resolves to the same slot

style.track.checked.source: Switch.css .saltSwitch-checked .saltSwitch-track { border-color: selectable-borderColor-selected; color: selectable-foreground-selected } — no background rule, box-bg is UNCHANGED from rest, repeated here deliberately

style.track.hover.source: Switch.css .saltSwitch:hover .saltSwitch-track { border-color: selectable-borderColor-hover; color: selectable-foreground-hover } — both resolve to the SAME accent slot as -selected

style.track.disabled.note: Salt applies a single flat opacity at the root instead — see style.root.disabled

style.track.readonly.source: Switch.css .saltSwitch-readOnly .saltSwitch-track { border-color: selectable-borderColor-readonly; color: content-primary-foreground } — selectable-borderColor-readonly resolves to the same palette-neutral value as rest

style.thumb.size@checked.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — Salt's thumb never changes size on check, only colour and position

style.thumb.size@pressed.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no :active rule of any kind

style.thumb.rest.source: Switch.css .saltSwitch-thumb { background: currentColor; border: var(--salt-size-fixed-100) solid var(--salt-selectable-borderColor) }

style.thumb.checked.source: Switch.css .saltSwitch-checked .saltSwitch-thumb { background: transparent; border-color: selectable-borderColor-selected; transform: translateX(100%) } — the fill-to-outline INVERSION

style.thumb.disabled.note: Salt applies a single flat opacity at the root instead — see style.root.disabled

style.thumb.readonly.source: Switch.css .saltSwitch-readOnly .saltSwitch-thumb, .saltSwitch-readOnly.saltSwitch-checked .saltSwitch-thumb { background: container-primary-background; border: fixed-100 dashed selectable-borderColor-readonly } — the IDENTICAL rule for both checked and unchecked

style.icon.size.source: CheckboxIcon/Icon component default --saltIcon-size: 100% — fills whatever thumb it sits in

style.root.font.source: Switch.css .saltSwitch { font-size/line-height/font-family/font-weight: var(--salt-text-*); color: var(--salt-content-primary-foreground) } — the BODY role, REGULAR (400)

style.state-layer.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — Salt has no ripple/state-layer concept for switch; hover and focus recolour the track/thumb directly
